items.title: Vidrush full media cold: asset discovery completo con tutti i provider
items.style: Write a vivid, concrete narrative. Each segment should describe a distinct visual scene. Use specific, searchable details that translate well to media queries.

source.topic: Three cinematic stories for full media asset discovery
source.source_text:
A surfer rides a massive wave at sunset on the North Shore of Oahu. The golden light reflects off the water as the board cuts through the curl.

A wildlife photographer tracks a snow leopard through the Himalayan mountains. Paw prints in fresh snow lead toward a rocky outcrop at dawn.

A jazz musician performs in a dimly lit New York club. Close-up on fingers moving across saxophone keys as smoke drifts through the spotlight.

Operational marker: vidrush-02-full-media-cold.
